new_observations.text: GSEM's first public repository commit was authored 2026-03-21, before the paper's 2026-03-23 submission, and already contained both forced-fill and no-fill multi-start retrieval implementations.

At that first public commit the normal retriever force-records the start node when a path selected nothing, while the no-fill counterpart documents the sole behavioral difference as preserving the empty result instead of backfilling.

The first public commit also exposes GSEMMultiStartNoFillAgent as 'Ablation 4' and lists it in the evaluation README, establishing forced-fill versus abstention preservation as an explicit pre-submission experimental factor.

No numerical outcome for this Ablation 4 was found in the inspected paper retrieval table or public repository surfaces. Thus its implementation does not establish whether no-fill improves or harms performance/safety.

new_protocol_inferences.name: ABLATION_IMPLEMENTATION_IS_NOT_ABLATION_OUTCOME_EVIDENCE
new_protocol_inferences.text: A matched ablation implementation establishes separability/testability, not causal direction or magnitude without a bound result.

new_protocol_inferences.name: ABSTENTION_SEMANTICS_REQUIRE_RESULT_BINDING_BEFORE_CANONICAL_PROMOTION
new_protocol_inferences.text: Keep the additive abstention-preservation checker outside canonical failure-memory v2 until a bound matched numerical result or independent outcome-bearing source supports promotion.

protocol_status.reason: Pre-submission code establishes a real separable factor, but no bound numeric no-fill outcome is available.

phase1_assessment.residual_dependency: The investigated scientist/medical memory systems remain model/tool dependent; the GSEM no-fill factor is implemented but its outcome evidence is missing.

exact_next_action: Search GSEM first-commit and subsequent public history for result artifacts, scripts, logs, tables, issue attachments, or supplementary files that bind a numerical outcome to GSEMMultiStartNoFillAgent versus normal forced-fill retrieval.

If no bound result exists, search an independent science/medical memory system where an all-rejected candidate set remains empty or rolls back, preferably with a fixed-candidate matched outcome comparison.
Continue the exact fixed-retrieved-record receiver-side applicability frontier; use TAG/QCR only as non-science causal controls and preserve their domain limits.

Continue ScientistOne export-sidecar, SciToolAgent-Evo enforced s_e, deterministic method-provenance, AI-CFD archive, EvoScientist evaluated-revision, and Duke cache-invalidation fronts as unresolved secondary lines.
Do not promote the abstention checker into canonical failure-memory v2 without outcome evidence.
